Supply chain security is the practice of protecting the outside software, vendors, services, and components an organization depends on.
supply-chain-attacks technique
Supply-chain-attacks are attacks that target the software or service creation process so many downstream users can be affected.
supply-chain-compromise
A supply-chain compromise is an attack that reaches victims through a trusted vendor, software package, update, or service provider.
suspicious activity concept
Suspicious activity is behavior that looks unusual or risky and may indicate fraud, hacking, or policy violations.
svchost.exe concept
A legitimate Windows process that hosts services, often abused by malware to blend in with normal system activity.
swatting technique
Swatting is making a false emergency report to send armed police or emergency responders to someone's location.
sweden other
Sweden is a country in Northern Europe.
synthetic content concept
Synthetic content is text, audio, images, or video created or heavily modified by software rather than directly captured from reality.
also: AI-generated content
SysExcSvc.dll malware
SysExcSvc.dll is a specific DLL file name referenced in security reporting as a likely malicious component or payload.
SysReadSvc.dll malware
SysReadSvc.dll is a specific DLL file name referenced in security reporting as a likely malicious component or payload.
system-level access concept
System-level access means very powerful control over a computer or server, often enough to change settings, install software, or steal data.
systemd tool
systemd is a common Linux system manager that starts services and manages system processes.
T1204.001 technique
T1204.001 is a MITRE ATT&CK technique for tricking a user into clicking a malicious link.
t1566-002
T1566.002 is the MITRE ATT&CK technique for phishing that uses malicious links in messages.
also: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
Take Control product
Take Control is a remote access and support product used by IT teams to connect to customer devices.
TAKEOVER technique
TAKEOVER is a named account-control or exploitation step referenced in security reporting.
takeover risks concept
Takeover risks are the chances that an attacker could gain control of an account, system, domain, or service.
targeted-phishing technique
Targeted phishing is a phishing attack aimed at specific people or organizations using tailored messages to seem more convincing.
TCP protocol
TCP is a core internet protocol that reliably sends data between computers by establishing a connection.
TCP port 4307 protocol
TCP port 4307 is a numbered network doorway that software can use to send and receive TCP traffic.
technical advisory committee organization
A technical advisory committee is a group of experts that gives practical guidance on specialized topics such as cybersecurity or infrastructure safety.
Technical analysis concept
Technical analysis is a detailed examination of how a system, vulnerability, malware sample, or attack works.
Technical systems concept
Technical systems are the computers, software, networks, and devices that support an organization's operations.
telegram
Telegram is a messaging app that supports channels, groups, bots, and encrypted chats.
Telegram bot tokens concept
Telegram bot tokens are secret keys that let software control a Telegram bot account.
Telegram bot upload technique
Telegram bot upload is a technique or feature where files or data are uploaded through a Telegram bot, sometimes used by attackers to steal information.
telegram-bot-exfiltration technique
Telegram bot exfiltration is a technique where stolen data is sent out through a Telegram bot controlled by an attacker.
Telemetry concept
Telemetry is data automatically collected from systems or devices to show what they are doing and whether something looks wrong.
Telnet administration services protocol
Telnet administration services let administrators manage a device over a network using Telnet, an older remote-access protocol that often lacks strong security.
also: Telnet
Teltonika organization
Teltonika is a company that makes networking and connectivity devices such as cellular routers used in industrial and business environments.
Teltonika cellular router product
A Teltonika cellular router is a network device that connects equipment to the internet or a private network using a mobile cellular connection.
also: Teltonika router
tenant concept
A tenant is a separate customer space inside a shared cloud or software service.
terrorism concept
Terrorism is the use or threat of violence to create fear and pursue political, ideological, or religious goals.
test environments concept
Test environments are separate systems used to safely try software or security changes before using them on real live systems.
The Com threat-actor
The Com is a loose online cybercriminal and social-engineering community referenced in security reporting.
also: Community, Com collective
The Gentlemen threat-actor
The Gentlemen is a threat-actor group referenced in security reporting.
The Information organization
The Information is a technology-focused news publication that reports on companies, startups, and the tech industry.
The True Cost of Building at Machine Speed other
The True Cost of Building at Machine Speed is a report or article title referenced in technology or security reporting.
the-hacker-news organization
The Hacker News is a cybersecurity news website covering breaches, vulnerabilities, and threat research.
third-party concept
A third party is an outside person, company, or service that is involved but is not the main organization or customer.
third-party dependence concept
Third-party dependence means relying on outside vendors, suppliers, or services that can affect an organization’s security and operations.
third-party platforms concept
Third-party platforms are outside services connected to a company’s own systems.
third-party services concept
Third-party services are outside companies or platforms an organization uses to help run its business or technology.
third-party vendor organization
A third-party vendor is an outside company that provides products or services to another organization.
also: unnamed third-party vendor
threat actor threat-actor
A threat actor is the person, group, or organization carrying out a cyberattack.
Threat actors concept
Threat actors are people or groups that carry out harmful activity against computers, websites, or organizations.
Threat categories concept
Threat categories are broad groupings used to sort cyber risks, such as malware, phishing, espionage, or data theft.
threat group threat-actor
A threat group is a set of attackers that security researchers track because they appear to share tools, targets, or behavior.
threat hunters other
Threat hunters are security analysts who actively search for hidden attackers or suspicious activity in systems and data.
threat hunting technique
Threat hunting is the proactive search for signs that attackers may already be inside a network or system.
threat information concept
Threat information is data about possible cyberattacks, attackers, tools, or warning signs that helps people defend systems.
threat intelligence concept
Threat intelligence is information collected and analyzed about possible or active cyber threats.
threat landscape concept
The overall picture of potential and existing cyber threats facing an individual, organization, or industry at a given time.
threat research concept
Threat research is the work of studying attackers, malware, vulnerabilities, and attack methods to improve defenses.
ThreatLabz organization
ThreatLabz is Zscaler's threat research team that analyzes attacks and publishes security research.
threats concept
Threats are possible dangers that could harm systems, data, devices, or users.
Tines product
Tines is a security automation platform used to build workflows for investigations, alerts, and response tasks.
Todd Larsen other
Todd Larsen is an individual referenced in security, business, or legal reporting.
also: Larsen
Token theft technique
Token theft is stealing a digital access token that can let an attacker act like a logged-in user or application.
tokens concept
Digital objects used for authentication, identification, or authorization, like access tokens.
TONTOU malware
TONTOU is a malware family or cyber tool name referenced in security reporting.
Tool-augmented model concept
A tool-augmented model is an AI system that can use external tools, such as web search or code execution, to complete tasks.
tooling concept
Tooling means the software and utilities people use to perform tasks such as development, testing, or security operations.
tools and infrastructure concept
Tools and infrastructure are the software, servers, accounts, and services used to carry out or support an operation.
TP-Link organization
TP-Link is a company that makes networking equipment such as home routers, switches, and Wi-Fi devices.
TP-Link Omada product
TP-Link Omada is a business networking product line for managing Wi-Fi access points, switches, and routers.
Traceability concept
Traceability is the ability to track an item, change, or action through its history and records.
tracking concept
Monitoring of online behavior, often through cookies and scripts, for advertising or malicious profiling.
Traditional identity and access management concept
Traditional identity and access management is the standard practice of managing users, logins, roles, and permissions in an organization.
transcription concept
Transcription is the process of turning spoken audio into written text.

Translate is a service or feature for converting words, speech, or text from one language to another.
travel bans concept
Travel bans are legal restrictions that stop certain people from entering or leaving countries.
Triada malware
Triada is an Android malware family known for hiding deeply on devices and enabling fraud or other malicious activity.
triage concept
The process of quickly sorting and prioritizing security alerts to decide which ones need immediate attention.
triple extortion technique
Triple extortion is a ransomware tactic that combines encrypting data, stealing data, and pressuring victims or third parties to pay.

trojan activity malware

A trojanized application is a normal-looking app that has been secretly modified to include malicious code.

Trusted-Infrastructure-Abuse technique
Trusted-Infrastructure-Abuse is a technique where attackers misuse legitimate services or infrastructure to make their activity look trustworthy.
tunnel concept

Twitch product

TXTBOOK malware
TXTBOOK is a malware family referenced in security reporting.
U.K. AI Security Institute organization

U.S. applications product
U.S. applications are software programs or services made, hosted, or used in the United States.
U.S. critical infrastructure concept
U.S. critical infrastructure means the essential systems and services in the United States, such as power, water, transport, healthcare, and communications.
U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency organization
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency is the U.S. government agency that helps protect critical infrastructure and improve cybersecurity.
U.S. developers organization
U.S. developers are software developers based in or associated with the United States.
U.S. Federal Civilian Executive Branch organization
The U.S. Federal Civilian Executive Branch is the group of non-military federal agencies under the U.S. executive branch.
U.S. prosecutors organization
U.S. prosecutors are government lawyers who bring criminal cases on behalf of the United States.
U.S. Treasury organization
The U.S. Treasury is the U.S. government department responsible for federal finances, sanctions, and financial-crime enforcement functions.
UK AI Security Institute organization
The UK AI Security Institute is a United Kingdom government-backed organization focused on evaluating and improving AI safety and security.
UK Department for Education organization
The UK Department for Education is the UK government department responsible for education and children's services in England.
also: UK DfE
UK Department for Education organization
The UK Department for Education is the government department responsible for education policy in England.
ukraine other
Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe that is often discussed in cybersecurity because of major cyberattacks linked to regional conflict.
Ultimate Post Kit product
Ultimate Post Kit is a WordPress plugin product used to display and customize posts on a website.
Ultimate Store Kit product
Ultimate Store Kit is a WordPress plugin product used to add or customize online store features.
unauthenticated concept
Unauthenticated means a user or attacker has not proven who they are with a login, password, token, or similar check.
unauthenticated attackers concept
Unauthenticated attackers are people who can attack a system without first logging in.

Unauthenticated command injection is a vulnerability that lets someone run system commands without logging in first.
unauthenticated, god-mode access vulnerability
Unauthenticated, god-mode access means getting complete control of a system without needing to log in.
also: full administrative control
unauthorized access concept
Unauthorized access means getting into a computer, account, system, or data without permission.
